name: Valley of Strength
summary: Trade and daily business fill Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. The bank, central auction house, and Broken Tusk inn draw travelers through the Horde capital.

sections.title: The Gates of the City
sections.body: Beyond Orgrimmar's timber gates, the Valley of Strength opens among Durotar's red canyon walls. Adventurers, merchants, and warriors from allied nations fill the Horde's front square. At the Broken Tusk inn, some trade war stories over flagons. Others turn to business at the central bank and auction house. The orcs fought for strength and unity in their new homeland, and both shape the city's heart.

sections.title: Hub of Trade and Command
sections.body: The Valley of Strength is Orgrimmar's foremost marketplace. Soran's Leather and Steel Armory sells armor, while vendors stock provisions for long treks across the Barrens. Grunts watch every corner. They guide newcomers and keep order among the diverse peoples who have taken refuge beneath Thrall's banner.

faq.q: What is the Valley of Strength?
faq.answer: Just inside Orgrimmar's main gates, the Valley of Strength holds the bank, auction house, general goods merchants, and Broken Tusk inn.

faq.q: Where is Grommash Hold located relative to this valley?
faq.answer: Grommash Hold lies north of the Valley of Strength, in the Valley of Wisdom. It is Warchief Thrall's seat and the Horde's high command.

faq.q: What services can I find here?
faq.answer: The valley has the city's main bank and auction house, trade supplies, armor at Soran's Leather and Steel Armory, lodging at the Broken Tusk, and general trade goods.

faq.q: Who guards the Valley of Strength?
faq.answer: Orgrimmar Grunts patrol the Valley of Strength. These seasoned orc warriors keep the peace, protect incoming caravans, and guide travelers through the canyon city.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you first meet others to trade and recruit for expeditions in the Valley of Strength, the plaza just inside Orgrimmar's gates.
